'pCVar4[1].base.base.create_event + 8' walks 1 x sizeof(CEnemy) (0x10af8) + offsetof(base.base.create_event) (0x78) + 0x8 = 0x10b78, which is exactly offsetof(CBatman, part_indices[7]). Ghidra had no CBatman type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CBatman *)pCVar4)->part_indices[7] (§de-pun/§12).
